notes.title: Next Fest Recap + First Sneak Peek at Game Modes!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]First off, thank you to everyone who played [i]Continuum Keeper[/i] during Steam Next Fest. We’re really happy with how it went — the feedback, support, and wishlist adds have been a huge help as we continue development.[/p][p]As promised, here’s the first of our updates on what’s coming next.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Two Core Game Modes (with more ideas in the works)[/h3][p][b]Observation Mode[/b]
This will be the main mode of [i]Continuum Keeper[/i]. You’ll monitor various locations, watch for Fractures, and report them using a streamlined report menu. The focus is on careful observation, memory, and quick decisions under pressure.[/p][p][b]Direct Intervention Mode[/b]
For players looking for an extra challenge, this mode removes the report menu. Instead, you’ll need to manually click directly on the Fracture itself and identify its type. This mode rewards precision and sharp attention.[/p][p]We’re also exploring ideas for a possible third mode — we’ll share more about that in a future update.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]What’s next[/h3][p]We’re working on more sneak peeks to share soon, including new Fracture types and updated environment previews. We’re also in the process of setting up social media pages so it’s easier to follow along with development outside of Steam. We’ll post links once those are ready.[/p][p]If you haven’t yet:
👉 [b]Wishlist [i]Continuum Keeper[/i] — it really helps us out![/b]
👉 [b]Join our Discord to stay up to date:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/KvG6khkqTs"]CC Discord Link[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][i](Screenshot: A new camera distortion effect — shown in-game with the updated ui.)[/i][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/7VVbnhi.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes – [v D1.0]
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Thank you all for playing the Continuum Keeper demo and sharing your feedback. Here’s a small update to address a few bugs and polish up the experience.[/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Changes:[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Clock no longer flickers[/b] when switching between cameras.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Report Menu now has a cooldown[/b] to prevent accidental spam reports.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Fixed (hopefully!) the issue where reports failed to submit.[/b][/p][quote][p]If you still encounter this, please replicate it and send in a bug report![/p][/quote][/*][*][p] [b]Previous selections in the Report Menu now highlight[/b] when reporting.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Minor map tweaks and polish[/b] across both levels.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re continuing to improve based on your feedback. Thanks for playing, and keep watching the fractures! [/p][p]— SirPepperPot[/p]

notes.title: Training Manual Update – Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Keepers!

A new update has just been deployed based on player feedback, and we’re excited to share what’s new:

• New Feature: Training Manual
A comprehensive in-game manual has been added to help new and returning recruits better understand their duties. This guide breaks down each type of Fracture you may encounter and provides visual and behavioral clues to help you identify them with confidence.

• Achievement Fixes
Several achievements that weren’t unlocking correctly have now been fixed. Your efforts will now be recognized properly—go claim what you’ve earned!

Your continued feedback helps shape the experience, and we’re grateful for everyone playing and supporting the game. More updates are in the works, so stay sharp out there.

Enjoying the game or looking forward to trying it?
Adding Continuum Keeper to your wishlist helps a ton and ensures you won’t miss future updates!

– SirPepperPot

notes.title: Continuum Keeper Demo Now Live
notes.content:
The Continuum Keeper demo is officially live on Steam!

Step into the role of a Stabilizer, monitoring fractures in unstable environments. In this early demo, you’ll be watching over two eerie locations where space and logic are starting to break down:

  The Gas Station – A remote fueling station where something isn’t quite right.
  The Subway Train – A moving map with its own challenges and atmospheric twists.

Your job? Watch the cameras, detect Fractures, and report them before reality collapses.

  What’s in the demo:

Two playable locations

Camera-switching and fracture detection mechanics

Several types of fractures to uncover

A taste of the game's tension, mystery, and storytelling

  I’d love your feedback!

Share your thoughts or bug reports in the Community Hub

Wishlist the game to help boost visibility

  We’re also part of Steam Next Fest, kicking off June 9th 

Thank you so much for checking out the demo — I can't wait to hear what fractures you discover.

– SirPepperPot
